title: Continuum-marginal optimal transport: a mesh-free kernel method
abstract: arXiv:2604.24226v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper we study continuum-marginal optimal transport. Given a time-continuous family of probability marginals, the problem is to recover the minimum-energy velocity field whose flow reproduces every marginal. This problem is the continuum limit of the classical two-marginal Benamou--Brenier formulation, and also the deterministic limit of the Nelson problem of stochastic optimal transport. We propose a practical mesh-free solver for this problem. The weak continuity equation is embedded in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, yielding a sample-only objective that requires no spatial discretization. The velocity is parametrized by any linear-in-parameters dictionary or neural network, and is optimized by mini-batch stochastic methods. Synthetic experiments confirm that the method achieves accurate drift recovery and marginal consistency. The same computational framework also applies to the Nelson problem.

translated_title: 连续边际最优传输：一种无网格核方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究连续边际最优传输问题。给定一个时间连续的边际概率分布族，目标是恢复最小能量的速度场，其流动能够重现每一个边际分布。该问题是经典双边际Benamou-Brenier公式的连续极限，也是随机最优传输Nelson问题的确定性极限。我们提出了一种实用的无网格求解器。弱连续性方程被嵌入到再生核希尔伯特空间中，得到一个仅依赖样本的目标函数，无需空间离散化。速度场通过任意线性参数字典或神经网络参数化，并通过小批量随机方法优化。合成实验证实该方法能够实现精确的漂移恢复和边际一致性。相同的计算框架也适用于Nelson问题。
tldr: 本文提出一种无网格核方法求解连续边际最优传输问题，通过将弱连续性方程嵌入再生核希尔伯特空间，实现仅依赖样本的优化，无需空间离散化，并适用于Nelson问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a mesh-free kernel method for continuum-marginal optimal transport, embedding the weak continuity equation in a reproducing kernel Hilbert space to enable sample-only optimization without spatial discretization, also applicable to the Nelson problem.
